explanation: Bulk system-end transmission line relays must not operate at or below 115% of maximum current flow from the system to the load under any system configuration.
Load-end transmission line relays must not operate at or below 115% of maximum current flow from the load to the system under any system configuration.
Transformers must be designed to withstand a winding hot spot temperature of 180°C to prevent damage.
Bubble formation may occur in transformers if winding hot spot temperature exceeds 140°C, which could affect performance.
Phase protection relays must not operate at or below 115% of circuit capability limitations to avoid unintended tripping.
